name: smac-micro-icl
note: Compact playbook for Laya ICL. State prefix is kept; tail is truncated at 512 tokens.
global: Allies spawn west, enemies east. If no enemy in sight, walk E.
Living units never no-op. Dead units only no-op.
Attack is legal only inside shoot range 6. Sight is 9. Walk before shooting if d>6.

focus.when: Same unit type, especially marines. Also 5v6.
focus.do: Every ally attacks the SAME enemy. Prefer lowest hp already in shot. Never split fire.

closest.when: Mixed composition (stalkers + zealots vs the same).
closest.do: Shoot the nearest enemy, not the weakest. Melee tanks, ranged stay behind.

alternate.when: Two ranged units vs one static or high-dps target (spine crawler).
alternate.do: Only ONE unit fires (cooldown ready, higher hp). The partner must walk out of range. Swap after each volley.

kite.do: If cooldown ready and in range, shoot. Then walk AWAY. Never let melee close.
